Native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]], '''Sloats''' were large carnivorous [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like creatures with long [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] and large feathered wings. They were attracted to the [[glowdart]], another creature on Wielu. A [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] named [[Shon Ti'Ja]] owned a sloat on the planet.<ref name="TCW" />

Since Wielu was commercialized, sloats, and several other creatures, were deemed dangerous and were forced out of their habitats. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] used their symbiotic relation with the glowdart to enter the base of the crime boss [[Traygura]].<ref name="TCW" />
